scenarios.title: Follow suit with a heart at risk
scenarios.prompt: Tutor led {lead}{suit}. Right is void in {ledName} and discarded {heart}H. Choose a legal card.

scenarios.title: Discard while void in the led suit
scenarios.prompt: Tutor led {lead}{suit}. Right followed {right}{suit}. You have no {ledName}. Choose a discard.

scenarios.title: Dump hearts under a locked winner
scenarios.prompt: Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor followed {tutor}{suit}. Right is winning with A{suit}. You have no {ledName}, so you can unload danger.

scenarios.title: Duck the ace of hearts
scenarios.prompt: Left led {lead}H. Tutor followed {tutor}H. Right followed {right}H. Avoid taking the heart trick with AH.

scenarios.title: Duck the queen trick
scenarios.prompt: Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor played Q{suit}. Right followed {right}{suit}. Choose without capturing the queen.

scenarios.title: Discard when the queen is already loose
scenarios.prompt: Tutor led {lead}{suit}. Right played Q{suit}. You are void in {ledName}. Choose a discard.

scenarios.title: Dump a queen under a locked winner
scenarios.prompt: Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor followed {tutor}{suit}. Right is winning with A{suit}. You have no {ledName}, so a queen discard is safe for you.

scenarios.title: Shed a queen under the ace
scenarios.prompt: Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor is already winning with A{suit}. Right followed {right}{suit}. If you must follow, a queen can be safe under the ace.

scenarios.title: Stay under the king
scenarios.prompt: Tutor led {lead}H. Right played KH, the contract card. Choose a heart without capturing it.

scenarios.title: Escape the king when you are void
scenarios.prompt: Tutor led {lead}H. Right played KH. You have no hearts, so choose any discard.

scenarios.title: Dump Barbu under a locked winner
scenarios.prompt: Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor followed {tutor}{suit}. Right is winning with A{suit}. You are void in {ledName}, so KH can be unloaded safely.

scenarios.title: Shed KH under the ace
scenarios.prompt: Left led {lead}H. Tutor is already winning with AH. Right followed {right}H. KH can be shed when the ace is locked above it.

scenarios.title: Duck the twelfth trick
scenarios.prompt: This is trick 12. Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor played J{suit}. Right followed {right}{suit}. Avoid winning the late trick.

scenarios.title: Forced late winner
scenarios.prompt: This is trick 13. Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor played {tutor}{suit}. Right followed 10{suit}. Your only led-suit card is dangerous.

scenarios.title: Prepare for the final tricks
scenarios.prompt: This is trick 11. Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor played 10{suit}. Right followed {right}{suit}. Avoid taking the lead into the final two tricks.

scenarios.title: Keep an exit before the finish
scenarios.prompt: This is trick 10. Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor played {tutor}{suit}. Right is winning with J{suit}. Stay out of lead before the dangerous finish.

scenarios.title: Duck the trick
scenarios.prompt: Tutor led {lead}{suit}. Right followed with K{suit}. Avoid taking control of the trick.

scenarios.title: Forced trick winner
scenarios.prompt: Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor played {tutor}{suit}. Right followed 9{suit}. Your only led-suit card wins.

scenarios.title: Discard under a locked winner
scenarios.prompt: Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor followed {tutor}{suit}. Right is winning with A{suit}. You have no {ledName}, so any discard stays clear.

scenarios.title: Duck from last seat
scenarios.prompt: Left led {lead}{suit}. Tutor is winning with Q{suit}. Right followed {right}{suit}. You can see the whole trick before choosing.

scenarios.title: Find the trump trick
scenarios.prompt: Tutor led {lead}{suit}. Right followed A{suit}. Hearts are trumps, and you have no {ledName}.

scenarios.title: Win while following suit
scenarios.prompt: Tutor led {lead}{suit}. Right followed {right}{suit}. You can follow {ledName} and still chase the trick.

scenarios.title: Overtrump for the trick
scenarios.prompt: Tutor led {lead}{suit}. Right already trumped with {right}H. You are void in {ledName}, so choose whether to overtrump.

scenarios.title: Follow before trumping
scenarios.prompt: Tutor led {lead}{suit}. Right followed {right}{suit}. Hearts are trumps, but you still hold {ledName} and must follow before trumping.

scenarios.title: Place into the Domino layout
scenarios.prompt: Domino is open on spades from the current lane, and unopened suits need a seven. Choose a legal placement.

scenarios.title: Choose between open lanes
scenarios.prompt: Spades and hearts are both open. Choose a card that extends one current lane by one rank.

scenarios.title: Open a new suit
scenarios.prompt: Only spades are open. A new suit must start with its seven; otherwise extend the spade lane by one rank.

scenarios.title: Avoid jumping a lane
scenarios.prompt: One suit is open through the eight, and spades are open from seven. Choose a card adjacent to an open lane; do not jump ranks.
